items.title: ASOS links data breach to social engineering attack, credential theft
items.summary: ASOS confirmed on Oct 8 that the breach behind its hijacked app notifications began with a social engineering attack: an attacker impersonated a trusted contact to steal an employee's login credentials, then used them to pull names, contact details, and account info from third-party platforms. Snowflake says its own platform was not compromised.

items.title: CISA sets Oct. 11 deadline for 5 CVEs exploited by Flax Typhoon
items.summary: CISA added five vulnerabilities exploited by the China-linked Flax Typhoon group — affecting ProFTPD, ONLYOFFICE Docs, Strapi, Apache Struts, and ISC BIND — to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Oct 8. Federal civilian agencies have a 72-hour window until Oct 11 to patch or decommission affected systems.

items.title: SonicWall SMA1000 flaw exploited just three days after patch release
items.summary: Attackers began exploiting CVE-2026-102255, a maximum-severity flaw in SonicWall SMA1000 secure remote access appliances, only three days after the patch was released on Oct 6. The unauthenticated request-handling weakness in the Appliance WorkPlace interface lets remote attackers reach internal functionality without logging in.

items.title: 2,100 GPU servers expose NVIDIA DCGM Exporter with high-severity flaw
items.summary: Lava Security researchers found roughly 2,100 GPU servers exposing NVIDIA's DCGM Exporter to the internet without authentication, leaking telemetry from 12,000+ GPUs worth about $100M. A high-severity flaw (CVE-2026-47483, CVSS 8.2) lets unauthenticated attackers crash the monitoring service via profiling requests; upgrade to 4.8.2.

items.title: AhsayCBS flaws exploited to deploy webshells and mine crypto
items.summary: Threat actors are exploiting one critical and one medium-severity vulnerability in the AhsayCBS backup management platform to achieve remote code execution, deploy webshells, and install XMRig cryptocurrency miners. Defenders should restrict access to internet-facing AhsayCBS management interfaces and check for compromise.
